title: A sign-in step's time limit, stated and enforced
assertion: The new-password, enrolment and code steps say "This step stays open for 3 minutes." before their work, and key registration says 15 minutes (a page rendered later in the step says the time left instead, "This step closes within 2 minutes.", rounded up), from one constant that infra's sign-in session and access token pin: the shorter of the provider's limit and the pending cookie's; the dev provider's challenge reads the same constant; the server closes a step at that limit, counted from before the provider issued its challenge, whatever the cookie's own life, and the rewrite after a refused new password extends nothing; a page or a press after the limit starts again without asking the provider and counts no failure; a step sealed before the deploy shows no countdown and is left to the provider
noFileReason: Synthetic personas sign in through the local identity provider on an injected clock and in the browser, and the limit is read from infra’s source text; no file.
